value.title: pij-rs-send-defaults
value.summary: pij-rs verbs derive the acting seat from the pane and mint message ids themselves, accept bodies from a file or stdin, and refuse a caller-asserted sender that disagrees with the pane — so agents stop typing --from/--msg-id boilerplate and never pass untrusted text as a shell argument.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Jordan 2026-09-02: agents write `pij-rs send --from <self> --to <peer> --msg-id "$(uuidgen)" --body '…'` on every call — wasteful, and the only rs send form takes the body as a literal shell argument. Also (antelope): `export PIJ_SESSION_ID` is a no-op for Claude/Copilot/Codex seats (fresh shell per command), so `pij-rs inbox` fails with no seat after a successful adopt; and the rs pointer text says `run: pij inbox` which is the unrouted bare legacy verb. Rows: req-0041 (+ req-0032 silent usage on missing --msg-id, req-0039(e) body-file as a legacy-shutdown precondition). The shimmed `pij send <id> <text>` already derives sender by pane and mints the id (crates/daemon/src/http/shim.rs, identity::resolve_seat) — the raw CLI must reach parity.

sections.name: goals
value: G1 Identity: every pij-rs verb that needs the acting seat resolves it as PIJ_SESSION_ID → else the pane ($TMUX_PANE against /v1/seats) → else a named refusal that says which env/flag to supply. A supplied --from/--seat that DISAGREES with the pane owner is refused by name (never silently honoured).

G2 send: --from optional (derived), --msg-id optional (minted as a UUIDv7/ULID by the CLI, echoed in the receipt), --body OR --body-file <path> OR --body-file - (stdin); missing all three = refusal naming the options; a body that starts with `-` is never parsed as a flag.
G3 Misuse is loud: any missing required input prints a one-line refusal and exits non-zero; usage text is never printed on a failed send (req-0032).

G4 Pointer/notice text: the daemon's `message waiting` line says `pij inbox check` (routed) not bare `pij inbox`; adopt output for claude/copilot/codex stops instructing `export PIJ_SESSION_ID` and says the pane resolves identity.
G5 Help shows the short form first: `pij-rs send --to <id> --body '…'` and `pij-rs send --to <id> --body-file -`.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No change to the shim (`pij send`) semantics.

value.text: LIVE from a hand-started omp AND a hand-started claude pane in tmux: `pij-rs send --to <peer> --body hello` with NO --from/--msg-id, no PIJ_SESSION_ID exported → receipt shows the derived sender and a minted id; peer receives it; transcript pasted.
value.claim: send derives the sender from the pane and mints the id
value.receipt: assets/live-send-defaults.md — hand-started OMP %2992 and Claude %2993 receipts name derived sender + UUIDv7

value.text: LIVE: `printf '%s' '--not-a-flag body with $(danger) and backticks' | pij-rs send --to <peer> --body-file -` delivers the bytes verbatim; a 5 KB file via --body-file <path> arrives byte-identical (reader compares).
value.claim: bodies from file/stdin are verbatim and never shell-parsed
value.receipt: assets/live-send-defaults.md — literal stdin payload delivered; 5120-byte file compared byte-identical

value.text: Unit: --from that disagrees with the pane owner → refusal naming both ids, exit non-zero, nothing sent; missing body → refusal naming --body/--body-file, no usage dump; pane absent and no env → refusal naming both; PIJ_SESSION_ID present wins over pane. RED-first.
value.claim: asserted identity cannot override derived identity and failures are named

value.text: LIVE: `pij-rs inbox` from a claude pane with no PIJ_SESSION_ID resolves by pane and reads (antelope case); the daemon pointer line reads `run: pij inbox check`; adopt output no longer says export for claude.
value.claim: identity derivation covers inbox and the notice texts are correct

value.claim: cross-seat inbox reads are explicit and non-destructive
value.text: Unit + LIVE: from a derived seat, `pij-rs inbox --seat <other>` without `--peek` is refused naming both ids before any claim or ack; `--peek` is the only permitted cross-seat read and does not claim or acknowledge the other seat's messages; help leads with the destructive own-inbox form.
value.receipt: assets/live-send-defaults.md — destructive cross-seat refusal then peek and owner read same msg_id
